venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Wednesday 11/11 (MOD/Chef Kyler, Steves; entered by Thomas; posted 2:01am 11/12)** Net $5,692 vs target $4,840 (118%). Food $460, beverage $5,232; comps $106.86 (incl. $60 investor discount; 15+ investors/members). 156 guests (SevenRooms); check avg $36.49 (form $37). Solid build and smooth service despite lumpy arrivals; one bumpy ~45 min at service pass with multiple large member/investor parties ordering off-menu. 3 large parties, 8 solos, 12 investor cocktails. Top sellers: Native Lion, High Plains Drifter; lots of agave. Door: full by 7pm, waitlist held to 8:30, another walk-in wave at 10:30pm; one late overserved resy turned away; one guest attempted to walk on a bill and broke a glass. 1 no-show (not charged). Breakage: 1 tulip, 1 DOF, 1 water glass.

Food $1,201; comps $281.84 (3.3%; DNLs, investors, gifts, service recovery incl. one walk-out). 152 guests; check avg $56.18 (net/guests — form reported $90.60, which doesn't reconcile with net). Quick ticket times (Josh and Kevin). Maintenance: soap dispenser/handwashing sink pending, oven part arrived (hopefully fixed by Friday). 86 pineapple juice (restocked mid-service). **Incident/injury reported: Yes** (no details given). No-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.weather: Lovely, cooler as the night went on

Marquee bar / total sales $3,616.85 (form), food $504.90; discounts $145.29 (member/investor 10%, DNL, employee 50%, F&F 15%, gift). 82 guests (56 walk-in / 26 resos); check avg $39.99 (net/guests; form $41.67). No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.weather: Overcast and cool; Veterans Day parade traffic
venues.narrative: **MG — Wednesday 11/11 (AM Shannon; PM James and Drew; entered by James; posted 11:39pm 11/11)** Net $6,878 vs target $6,790 (101%). Morning bar $1,408, evening bar $3,260, event $2,210; Sun Club and Hot Eye closed; food $3,120; comps $161. 132 guests (9 AM + 123 PM OpenTable); check avg $52.11 (net/guests, incl. event). Kitchen slow and steady, cut one cook ~7pm, no send-backs. Event went smoothly (Sam and Sierra). No incidents; nothing new on maintenance.
